0022600128.text: The Celtics (2-1, 2-0 at home, riding a two-game winning streak) host the Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) in Boston's fourth game of the season. Boston is second in the Atlantic, half a game back, and fifth in the East, while Brooklyn is fifth in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and 14th in the East. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, and Brooklyn will be without Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder sprain, while Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with rest and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 148-111 win in Boston on February 27, 2026.
